games.title: Nyan Noodle
games.blurb: Run a cozy ramen shop for a crew of very particular cats. Prep bowls, serve tickets, and keep the broth flowing.

games.title: Monster League Arcade
games.blurb: Retro-modern Halloween sports: football and hockey with a league of lovable monsters. Three games in one cabinet.

subpathBlocker.summary: Game HTML hardcodes root-absolute /assets/* and /football/ /hockey/ links; Vite --base only rewrites its own emitted assets.
subpathBlocker.requiredChange: Use base-relative asset URLs in the game source (import.meta.env.BASE_URL or VITE_BASE) and prefix internal links with the base path.

games.title: Space Tycoon
games.blurb: Build a freight empire among the stars. Planets, ships, trade routes and an unreasonable amount of paperwork.

games.title: Primordial Swamp
games.blurb: A scientifically accurate dinosaur roguelite inspired by Odell Lake. Survive the swamp, one prehistoric meal at a time.

subpathBlocker.summary: Vite copies only public/, but this repo keeps 42 game assets in repo-root assets/; runtime requests /assets/* which do not exist in dist/.
subpathBlocker.requiredChange: Move assets/ into public/assets/ (or set publicDir: 'assets' in vite.config.ts) and load them via import.meta.env.BASE_URL so they resolve under /primordial-swamp/.

games.title: Astrolog
games.blurb: Space Logistics Tycoon: chart trade routes between star systems, run freighter fleets and outmaneuver rival shipping lines.

games.title: Cat Herding
games.label: NES homebrew (WIP)
games.blurb: An alley-cat platformer for the original NES, written in 6502 assembly. Plays right here in your browser via jsnes.
